reference_sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', paid_at) AS DATE) AS month,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT refunded) AS kept_payments,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE refunded) AS refunded_payments
FROM payments
WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', paid_at) AS DATE)
alternatives:
SELECT month, "false" AS kept_payments, "true" AS refunded_payments
FROM (
  -- one row per payment of 2025
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', paid_at) AS DATE) AS month, refunded
  FROM payments
  WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
) AS p
PIVOT (COUNT(*) FOR refunded IN (false, true) GROUP BY month)

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', paid_at) AS DATE) AS month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN refunded THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS kept_payments,
  SUM(CASE WHEN refunded THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_payments
FROM payments
WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', paid_at) AS DATE)

solver.query:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS month,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT refunded) AS kept_payments,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE refunded) AS refunded_payments
FROM payments
WHERE (paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND (paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY 1
